name: Kempinski Hotel Corvinus Budapest
positioning: Kempinski hotel in downtown Budapest, a short walk from Vörösmarty Square
best_for: Travelers who want a central downtown Budapest base
Business travelers who want a central location and premium services

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Budapest.
The hotel is a short walk from Vörösmarty Square and its Christmas market.
The hotel's address is Erzsébet tér 7, Budapest.
A spa package combines a city break with a course of massage treatments.
Condé Nast Traveler lists a bar, free wifi, a gym, a pool and a spa among the hotel's amenities.
The hotel offers a business package, with premium services and a super-central location.
The hotel promotes romantic getaways, proposal trips, honeymoons and anniversary trips.
Condé Nast Traveler listed the hotel in its Readers' Choice Awards in 2017 and 2018.
